meta.title: Wemuste — private connections between workers and employers
meta.description: Find side jobs or full-time work. Your profile is never public: only employers approved by Wemuste can see it.

landing.headline: Work that fits your life
landing.subhead: Wemuste connects people looking for work with verified employers — privately.
landing.step1Body: Answer a few questions. It takes about 15 minutes.
landing.step2Body: Our team reviews every employer and every profile.
landing.step3Body: Approved employers invite you to a meeting.
landing.chooseTitle: How do you want to use Wemuste?
landing.employeeCardBody: Find a side job or full-time work. Free.
landing.trustLine: No public profiles. No spam. Employers only see what we approve.

authShell.valueTitle: Real work. Real employers. Your privacy first.
authShell.valueBody: Wemuste keeps your information private and shares it only with employers we have checked.
authShell.trust2: Every employer is verified by our team
authShell.trust3: You decide which meetings to accept
authShell.employerValueTitle: Hire from a vetted, private talent pool.
authShell.employerValueBody: Every candidate is reviewed by Wemuste before you see them.
authShell.employerTrust1: Candidates are screened with surveys, tests and video
authShell.employerTrust2: Access is granted per candidate by our team
authShell.employerTrust3: Request meetings in a few taps

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Log in to continue.
login.resetDone: Your password was changed. Please log in again.
login.signedOutAll: You have been logged out on all devices.
login.linkInvalid: That link is invalid or has expired. Please try again.

signup.employeeSubtitle: It only takes a minute. You'll build your profile next.
signup.employerSubtitle: Our team reviews every company before it can see candidates.
signup.acceptTerms: I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
signup.acceptDataSharing: I understand my information is stored privately and shared only with employers approved and selected by Wemuste.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.body: We sent a link to {email}. Tap the link to activate your account.
verify.bodyNoEmail: We sent you a link. Tap the link in the email to activate your account.
verify.tip: Can't find it? Check your spam or junk folder.
verify.resent: Done. If the account needs activating, a new email is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that email, we've sent a link to reset your password.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You'll be logged out on all devices after the change.
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once and only for a short time. Please ask for a new one.

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.passwordWeak: This password is too easy to guess or has appeared in a data leak. Please choose another.
validation.passwordSame: Please choose a password you haven't used here before.
validation.companyTooLong: That company name is too long.
validation.licenseTooLong: That license number is too long.
validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number, e.g. +971 50 123 4567.
validation.acceptTerms: Please accept the Terms and Privacy Policy to continue.
validation.acceptDataSharing: Please confirm how your information is shared to continue.
validation.mfaCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your app.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please activate your account first. Check your email for the link.
errors.captchaFailed: We couldn't confirm you're human. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please request a new link.

employee.nextBody: Answer a short survey, take a quick test and record a short video. Employers never see anything until our team approves it.
employee.securityBody: Signed in on a shared phone or computer? Log out everywhere.

employer.pendingBody: Thanks for signing up {company}. Our team checks every company before it can see candidates. This usually takes 1–2 business days.
employer.pendingEmailNote: We'll email you as soon as you're approved.
employer.suspendedBody: Access to candidates is paused. Please contact Wemuste support for help.
employer.homeEmpty: No candidates yet. When our team shares candidates with you, they will appear here.

admin.mfaEnrollBody: Admins must use an authenticator app. Scan this code with Google Authenticator, 1Password or similar, then enter the 6-digit code.
admin.mfaVerifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
admin.mfaInvalid: That code didn't work. Please try again.
admin.homeBody: Employer approvals, employee review and access grants arrive in the next phases.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: Please try again. If it keeps happening, come back a little later.
